$comment: Controlled vocabulary for the CTRF freeform string fields EVerest depends on. Data, not schema, because it drifts: the gate WARNS on values outside it rather than rejecting, so a submission against a newer EVerest still lands. Grounded in EVerest's documented protocol surface (README.md 'Main Features') and its test suites.

escapeHatch.note: Anything an integrator needs that is not listed. The x- prefix keeps private tags from colliding with future standard ones, and keeps them out of the public per-protocol rollups.

$targetsNote: The four non-x86 entries are exactly what EVerest cross-builds in CI (on_pr.yaml bazel-cross-build matrix), so an integrator reporting one of these is directly comparable with upstream.
